title: Auth Service API v2
content:
API Documentation — Auth Service v2

Base URL: https://api.internal/auth/v2

All endpoints require Content-Type: application/json.

Authentication

POST /login

Authenticate with email and password.

Request:devos://page/01HWKP1234567890PAGEAPI0

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "hunter2"
}

Response 200:

{
  "access_token": "eyJ...",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900
}

Refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie: rt=<token>; Secure; SameSite=Strict

Errors:

Status

Code

Description

401

invalid_credentials

Email or password incorrect

429

rate_limited

Too many attempts. Retry after header contains wait time.

423

account_locked

Account locked after 10 failed attempts

POST /refresh

Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair.

Request: No body needed. Reads rt cookie automatically.

Response 200:

{
  "access_token": "eyJ...",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900
}

Errors:

Status

Code

Description

401

token_expired

Refresh token expired

401

token_reused

Token reuse detected — session invalidated

401

token_invalid

Token malformed or signature invalid

POST /logout

Invalidate the current session.

Request: No body needed.

Response 204: No content.

GET /me

Get the currently authenticated user.

Headers: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:

{
  "id": "01HW...",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "roles": ["engineer"],
  "created_at": "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z"
}

Tokens

GET /jwks.json

Public JSON Web Key Set for token verification.

Response 200:

{
  "keys": [
    {
      "kty": "RSA",
      "use": "sig",
      "kid": "2024-03-key-1",
      "n": "...",
      "e": "AQAB"
    }
  ]
}
